core_obligations: Identify the degreewise building blocks: for every open W contained in U the functor F -> F(W) is an additive exact functor from presheaves of O_X-modules to modules over O_X(U) (proof lines 1055-1057).

Use that products of exact functors are exact: the degree p term C^p-check(U, F) of the Cech complex is a product of these evaluation functors, hence exact, and the linear structure is carried along componentwise (proof lines 1058-1060).

Pass from terms to complexes: a sequence of complexes is exact exactly when the sequence of its terms in each fixed degree is exact, which gives exactness of the Cech complex functor (proof lines 1061-1062).
proof_roadmap: Note exactness of each evaluation functor into O_X(U)-modules (proof lines 1055-1057).
Observe that the Cech terms are products of such functors, hence exact (proof lines 1058-1060).
Conclude exactness of the functor on complexes from degreewise exactness (proof lines 1061-1062).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the functor assigning to a presheaf of O_X-modules its Cech complex with respect to a fixed open covering of a ringed space is exact (statement lines 1050-1051). The proof is three lines of structural reasoning, each of a different kind: evaluation at an open is exact, a product of exact functors is exact, and a sequence of complexes is exact exactly when it is exact in every degree (proof lines 1055-1062). The middle step is the one that matters, since the higher Cech terms are products rather than finite sums, and the linear structure over O_X(U) has to be kept throughout. The claim is H2: short, no constructions, but a correct assembly of three exactness facts into an exact functor on complexes.
